description: This file contains the main component of a Tic Tac Toe game, implemented with React. It manages the game state and renders the game board and the current status.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main component that handles the game logic and renders the Tic Tac Toe board.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Component representing a single square on the Tic Tac Toe board.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner based on the current state of the squares.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles the click event on the squares to update the game state.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.
